findings.source_quote: This is the first ... continuing to call men and women ... drawn to follow Jesus.
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Hii ni makala ya kwanza”; badili “anaendelea kuitisha wanaume na wanawake wajibu wa kujibu” kuwa “anaendelea kuwaita wanaume na wanawake kuitikia”, na “ukiwakaribishwa” kuwa “ukivutwa”.
findings.translation_quote: Huu ni makala ya kwanza ... anaendelea kuitisha wanaume na wanawake wajibu wa kujibu ... ukiwakaribishwa kumfuata Yesu.

findings.source_quote: You may experience both exhilaration and apprehension.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili sentensi kuwa “Unaweza kuhisi msisimko na pia wasiwasi.”
findings.translation_quote: Unaweza kujisikia kwa msisimko pamoja na wasiwasi.

findings.source_quote: an emptiness ... only Jesus can fill ... resonates with those heart longings ... we find ourselves being transformed.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “kuufunika” kuwa “kuujaza”; tumia “Kuna usafi na uzuri katika maisha ya Yesu unaoendana na shauku hizo za mioyo. Tunapotembea na Yesu, tunajikuta tukibadilishwa.”
findings.translation_quote: kuufunika ... yanayolingana na kutamani kwa mioyo hiyo ... tunakutana tukigeuzwa.

findings.source_quote: If you join us on this journey
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “Ukitushirikisha katika safari hii” kuwa “Ukijiunga nasi katika safari hii”.
findings.translation_quote: Ukitushirikisha katika safari hii

findings.source_quote: Follow me ... fishers of men. And they straightway left their nets
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “Nifuate” kuwa “Nifuateni”, “wawindaji samaki” kuwa “wavuvi”, na “wawindaji wa watu” kuwa “wavuvi wa watu”. Badili “Wakakata wavu wao mara moja” kuwa “Mara wakaziacha nyavu zao”.
findings.translation_quote: Nifuate ... wawindaji samaki ... wawindaji wa watu. Wakakata wavu wao mara moja

findings.source_quote: The sun was rising ... Fishing has been your life. You are as much at home on the sea as you are in your cottage.
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Jua lilikuwa likichomoza kwenye upeo wa mashariki”; badili “kuwindia samaki” kuwa “kuvua samaki”, na sentensi mbili za mwisho kuwa “Uvuvi umekuwa maisha yako. Unajisikia umetulia baharini kama ulivyo nyumbani katika kibanda chako.”
findings.translation_quote: Jua lilikuwa likinyoshwa ... kuwindia samaki ... Uwindaji umekuwa maisha yako. Umerahisi kama nyumbani baharini

findings.source_quote: keep the creditors at bay ... Your father was a fisherman. Your grandfather was a fisherman.
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “kuwazuia wadai wasikusumbue kwa wiki nyingine”, na badili “mwindaji samaki” katika sentensi zote mbili kuwa “mvuvi”.
findings.translation_quote: kumuweka mbali mkopeshaji ... Baba yako alikuwa mwindaji samaki. Babu yako alikuwa mwindaji samaki.

findings.source_quote: This morning ... a man approaches ... the local rabbi
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “Kila asubuhi” kuwa “Asubuhi hii”, “mtu mmoja akaruka karibu” kuwa “mtu mmoja anakaribia”, na “myezi wa mahubiri wa mahali” kuwa “rabi wa eneo hilo”.
findings.translation_quote: Kila asubuhi ... mtu mmoja akaruka karibu ... myezi wa mahubiri wa mahali

findings.source_quote: His approving nod ... time with the Nazarene would soften the temper of their abrasive characters.
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Kuitikia kwake kwa kichwa kwa kuonyesha ridhaa kulikuwa tu walichohitaji” na “Labda alikuwa akitumaini kwamba kukaa na Mnasareni kungepunguza ukali wa tabia zao.”
findings.translation_quote: Kurejea kichwa kwa ridhaa kwake ... wakati pamoja na Mnasareni unang’oa hasira ya tabia zao kali.

findings.source_quote: Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men ... tethered to a stump by the shore
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Nifuateni, nami nitawafanya kuwa wavuvi wa watu.” Badili “Waliwachia” kuwa “Waliacha”, na “kwenye kiti” kuwa “kwenye kisiki”. Mwishoni tumia “Labda ilikuwa shauku kubwa mioyoni mwa wanafunzi hawa—‘tumaini’ ambalo kumfuata Yesu kungeweza kulitimiza.”
findings.translation_quote: Nifuate ... wawindaji wa watu ... Waliwachia ... kwenye kiti ... “tumaini” kwamba kumfuata Yesu kunaweza kutimiza.

findings.location: html, paragraph beginning “Mizazi ya wanaume Wayahudi”
findings.source_quote: break the Roman yoke ... the most promising revolutionary prospect of the day ... they would never be the same.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “angenyanyasa ufunuo wa Kirumi” kuwa “angevunja nira ya utawala wa Kirumi”; tumia “Yesu ndiye aliyeonekana kuwa na matumaini makubwa zaidi ya kuleta mapinduzi wakati huo.” Badili “hawakuwa watoe sawa tena” kuwa “wasingebaki vile walivyokuwa tena”.
findings.translation_quote: angenyanyasa ufunuo wa Kirumi ... Yesu alikuwa tegemeo la msukumo la siku hizo ... hawakuwa watoe sawa tena.

findings.source_quote: the familiar, secure life of the fisherman ... an adventure
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “maisha ya kawaida, yenye usalama ya muwindaji” kuwa “maisha waliyozoea, yenye usalama, ya mvuvi”, na “msimu wa kusisimua” kuwa “safari yenye matukio ya kusisimua”.
findings.translation_quote: maisha ya kawaida, yenye usalama ya muwindaji ... msimu wa kusisimua

findings.source_quote: they could not resist the allure of the familiar ... He told them to cast on the right side of the ship.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “huwezi kukwepa mvuto wa yaliyo ya kawaida” kuwa “hawakuweza kuupinga mvuto wa mambo waliyoyazoea”; badili “Akawaambia wawatupie upande wa kulia wa mashua” kuwa “Akawaambia watupe nyavu upande wa kulia wa mashua”.
findings.translation_quote: huwezi kukwepa mvuto wa yaliyo ya kawaida ... Akawaambia wawatupie upande wa kulia wa mashua.

findings.source_quote: They went forth ... Cast the net ... they were not able to draw it
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “Wakamtoka” kuwa “Wakatoka”, “Mwatupie wavu” kuwa “Tupeni wavu”, na “hawakuweza kuvuza” kuwa “hawakuweza kuuvuta”.
findings.translation_quote: Wakamtoka ... Mwatupie wavu ... hawakuweza kuvuza

findings.source_quote: utter dependence upon Him ... no longer trust in yourself ... in my flesh ... dwelleth no good thing ... how to perform that which is good I find not
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Unapoamua kumfuata Yesu, atakuvuta katika hali ya kumtegemea yeye kabisa, kiasi kwamba hatimaye hutaendelea kujitumainia mwenyewe.” Ndani ya em tumia “…kwamba ndani yangu (yaani, katika mwili wangu,) halikai jambo jema…” na “…kwa maana nina nia ya kutenda mema; lakini sijui jinsi ya kuyatenda –Warumi 7:18.”
findings.translation_quote: Unapomamua ... utegemezi wake kamili ... hautaweza tena kumtumaini wewe mwenyewe ... hakuna kitu kizuri chaanayeishi ... kutaka kunikuwapo

findings.source_quote: could not have fathomed ... We commit the details to our Master.
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “Kama vile wanafunzi wasingeweza kufahamu kumfuata Yesu kungewapeleka wapi, sisi pia hatuwezi.” Badili sentensi ya mwisho kuwa “Tunamkabidhi Bwana wetu mambo yote ya safari hiyo.”
findings.translation_quote: hawangeweza kubahatisha ... Tunamipa Bwana wetu maelezo da details.

findings.source_quote: having put his hand to the plough, and looking back
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “kwenye plagi, akimtazama nyuma” kuwa “kwenye jembe la kukokotwa, akitazama nyuma”.

findings.source_quote: the weary disciples ... How gently piercing are the words of Jesus.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “wanafunzi waliochelemea” kuwa “wanafunzi waliochoka”; badili sentensi ya mwisho kuwa “Maneno ya Yesu yanapenya moyoni kwa upole ulioje!”
findings.translation_quote: wanafunzi waliochelemea ... Maneno ya Yesu yalikuwa na pemba laini yanayokata kwa undani.

findings.source_quote: Feed my lambs.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “Lisha ndugu zangu” kuwa “Lisha wana-kondoo wangu”.
findings.translation_quote: Lisha ndugu zangu.

findings.source_quote: Now Jesus is asking him to reciprocate that love.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili sentensi kuwa “Sasa Yesu anamwomba aitikie upendo huo kwa kumpenda pia.”
findings.translation_quote: Sasa Yesu anamwomba apendezane naye kwa upendo huo.

findings.translation_quote: akihojiwa kwa uongo, na kukamatwa mate ... aliyeendelea kumtaka kwamba ... “Sijui.” ... Yesu amenihukumu upendo wake.

findings.source_quote: In anguish of heart Peter cried out ... to emulate him.
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “Akilazwa kwa maumivu ya moyo Petro aliliita” kuwa “Akiwa na uchungu moyoni, Petro akalia kwa sauti”; badili “kumfanana naye” kuwa “kumwiga”.
findings.translation_quote: Akilazwa kwa maumivu ya moyo Petro aliliita ... kumfanana naye.

findings.translation_quote: Yesu hatumwiti bila kutubariki kwa vifaa, na hatusiagi hadi atakapothibitisha kwamba tuko tayari ... Petro aliiitwa ... alipewa neema.

findings.source_quote: another attribute of discipleship that is sometimes misplaced

findings.translation_quote: sifa nyingine ya ufuasi ambayo wakati mwingine hupangwa vibaya

findings.source_quote: your devoted love for Me
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “upendo wako uliotawanywa kwangu” kuwa “upendo wako wa dhati uliojitoa kwangu”.

findings.source_quote: it is not considered toil ... No sacrifice ... is a loss.
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia “kufanya kazi kwa ajili yake hakuonekani kuwa taabu” na “Hakuna kujitolea tunakofanya kwa ajili ya ufalme wa mbinguni ambako ni hasara.”
